content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Summary:** Section 11.6 contains a functioning mutual insurance regime (workers' compensation at statutory limits, employer's liability, general liability including clinical trial insurance, certificates of insurance on request, plus an unconditional AbbVie self-insurance right in 11.6.3), but there is no professional liability (E&O) or cyber/privacy coverage anywhere in the agreement. That fails the fallback insurance position.

**Cure (fallback level, one operation):** a new Section 11.6.1(d) requiring Harpoon to carry E&O of USD 1,000,000 and cyber and privacy liability of USD 2,000,000 — the exact fallback floors, no volunteered preferred limits, and drafted as a Harpoon-only obligation so it does not create a new mutual burden on AbbVie or disturb our self-insurance right.
